CHALLENGE:

1. Build a circuit that can connect 2 buttons to 2 LEDs! 
2. Choose a different LED color to correlate to each button
3. Use the LED and button colors in the variable name
NOT PART OF PRESENTATION…USED FOR CHECKING SOLUTION
#define BUTTON_RED  2
#define BUTTON_BLUE 3

#define LED_RED  8
#define LED_BLUE 9

bool button_state_red;
bool button_state_blue;


void setup()
{
  pinMode(BUTTON_RED,  INPUT);
  pinMode(BUTTON_BLUE, INPUT);
  pinMode(LED_RED,  OUTPUT);
  pinMode(LED_BLUE, OUTPUT);
}

void loop()
{
  button_state_red  = digitalRead(BUTTON_RED);
  button_state_blue = digitalRead(BUTTON_BLUE);
  
  if (button_state_red == HIGH) {
     digitalWrite(LED_RED, HIGH);
  } else {
     digitalWrite(LED_RED, LOW);
  }

  if (button_state_blue == HIGH) {
     digitalWrite(LED_BLUE, HIGH);
  } else {
     digitalWrite(LED_BLUE, LOW);
  }

  delay(100);
}
